messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "unknown in fibromyalgia"
set: ["unknown in fibromyalgia", "fibromyalgia in adults", "fibromyalgia", "unknown", "optimal unknown", "unknown if tumor formation occurs in humans", "fibromyalgia in children 13 years old or older", "unknown if these effects would occur in people", "unknown if harmful to unborn baby", "significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks", "changes in body fat in women", "given in muscle", "fluttering in chest", "depression in adults", "given in vein", "slower in cirrhosis"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
